name: Lord Ben Buren
source:
Ben has everything a male lead could hope for-including good looks, charm, wit and magical talent. 
Yet heroines in romance novels never choose the loyal yet boring childhood friend when more exciting men are around. Does that mean Ben truly is my friend?
